reader.requirement: At --std 85, MULTIPLY format 1 must hold literal-1 / identifier-1's value in a temporary (identified once), multiply each identifier-2 by it in left-to-right order and store each product into that identifier-2, so an identifier-2 that is identifier-1, or whose subscript an earlier identifier-2 changes, sees the temporary and the stored subscript value (§1985:VI.6.4.6).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 an unphrased size error is caught per receiver and the statement completes (catchesEveryCondition); from 2002 it is a fatal exception condition
CompositeMembers.ReceivingItems85 with Edition.Year < 2002: the composite is the receiving items only (§1985:VI.6.20.3 SR3), capped at Edition.MaxDigits = 18 at 85 (all operands, 31, from 2002)

reader.edition-search: grep of ArithmeticEmitter.cs, NumericRenderer.cs, ArithmeticBinder.cs, StatementValidation.cs for DialectBehavior/Edition/DialectLevel; the temporary (Fold + Snapshot when MaterializesInitialEvaluation) and the per-receiver store loop take no edition input
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the temporary and the left-to-right products; the unphrased size-error disposition and the composite cap differ (GR3's paragraphs), not this rule
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf14_05 L1 covers identifier-1 also an identifier-2; not exercised: a subscripted identifier-1 whose subscript an identifier-2 changes, signed/scaled/P operands, ROUNDED per receiver

probes.expected: M1: temp = T (2) = 3, I = 6, then T (6) = 9; M2: 7 * -3 stored unsigned 21; M3: C 17.5 ROUNDED 18, D 1.75 truncated 1.7; M4: P-scaled 3 * 200 = 600. All match.

probes.printed: COBOL1675 numeric-edited BY receiver; COBOL0844 alphanumeric item and alphanumeric literal operands; COBOL1689 literal after BY without GIVING; COBOL1675 alphanumeric GIVING receiver
probes.expected: §1985:VI.6.20.3 SR1/SR2 refusals; a literal cannot be a format 1 receiver

probes.printed: COBOL0803: ROUNDED MODE IS requires COBOL-2014 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: a later edition's phrase refused at 85

OK  §1985:VI.6.4.6  (6.4.6 Multiple Results in Arithmetic Statements)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GR1

reader.notes: EmitInPlace folds the multiplicand once and snapshots it when there are several receivers; StoreInPlace then forms receiver * value per receiver left to right, each receiver identified at its own store. No edition arm on this rule's path.

refuter.evidence: rmul1.cob at --std 85 (rmul1-001): MULTIPLY A BY A A with A=3 gives N1=27 (temporary 3: 3*3=9, then 3*9=27, as GR1 and §1985:VI.6.4.6 give); a phrased size error in format 1 BINARY BN2 PIC 99 5 BY 20 leaves 20 (N5 SIZE 20); explicit GO TO out of ON SIZE ERROR N9 50; NOT ON SIZE ERROR alone ignored on a size error N10 DONE. rmul2.cob --compile-only: MULTIPLY A BY EV EW with 9(17)V9 and V99 receivers refused COBOL0805 composite 19 digits. Grep of ArithmeticBinder.cs, ArithmeticEmitter.cs, NumericRenderer.cs: the only other edition test (ArithmeticEmitter.cs#UnsignedSubsidiary, DialectLevel >= 2002) is DIVIDE REMAINDER's, off this path. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.20.4 GR1 'the temporary data item is multiplied by each successive occurrence of identifier-2'; OK §1985:VI.6.20.3 SR3 'superimposition of all receiving data items'.
